title: Empannage install timeplase
description: This time-lapse captures the manufacturing of the X-59 aircraft from April 2022 through July 2022 after its return from Fort Worth, Texas to Lockheed Martin Skunk Works in Palmdale, California. The X-plane is in the final stages of assembly. The X-59’s first flight is planned for 2023.
